'''Guardian Hold Four''' was a building in [[Axial Park]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] that was one of the [[Guardian Holds]], special fortified installations throughout [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. The Hold was originally known as Bakvalen Hall, home of the [[Bakarn family]].
